title: Selected codec row bit
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with Boolean alphabet, let $n,s$ be natural numbers, let $r,t$ be codec rows, and let $p$ consist of a Boolean and a codec-bit coordinate. The selected bit is the bit of $t$ at that coordinate when the Boolean is true, and the bit of $r$ there when it is false.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine with Boolean alphabet
$p$ is a Boolean paired with a codec-bit coordinate for $M,n,s$
